implementation.name: original-v4-14-authority-handshake-fsm
implementation.scope: Original per-channel authority FSM. Ordered successful handover, manual lease loss, guarded reset, and an explicit protective-preemption alternative. Normalized blend progress is illustrative.
implementation.question: When does the proposal token change owner?

purpose: Make token revocation and profile ownership observable while preserving all original state boxes, guards, and edges.
guard: ACK is not commit. Blend is enforcer-owned. Fallback exits only from rest with re-admission. Protective preempts every state, including fallback. No safety certification is implied.
